# Shelter
中文
Immersive weather for DeepSeek Harness — rain, snow and hearth, with real recordings and a night mod
mersive weather for DeepSeek Harness — rain, snow and hearth, with real recordings and a night mode.
**Contents:** Scenes · Install · Usage · Audio · How it works · Development · Release · Credits
## What it is
Shelter is a thin layer of weather over the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Rain leaves beads on the glass
; snow drifts slowly outside; a fire glows under the composer.
It changes nothing about how DSH works — only the air you sit in while working. The entry point is a
28 px button in the bottom-right corner; the rest of the time it just rains, quietly.
## Scenes
| Scene | What you see | Palette |
| **Rain** | Streaks that each fall at their own speed, slant with the wind, and splash where they l

and | Cool blue-grey, deep navy shadows |
| **Snow** | Two kinds of crystal drifting through one win

d field, over a bank that grows as it snows | Colder and whiter, icy-blue accents |
| **Fire** | A w
arm pulse from below, rising embers, sparks, slow smoke | Warm neutrals, amber accents |
Semantic colors (error red, success green, warning amber) are untouched in every scene.

## Usage
Click the small button in the bottom-right corner:
| Control | Effect |

| Scene | rain / snow / fire / off |
| Intensity | light / medium / heavy |
| Palette | theme colors

on or off — the animation runs either way |
| Lightning | rain only: bolt, flash, thunder |
| Sound

| rain and fire recorded, snow wind generated |
| Night | dark palette plus a moonlight wash |
**Lightning.** A strike draws a branched bolt across the sky, flashes the pane, then bangs. The dela
y encodes distance — 0.3–0.9 s when close, 1.5–2.8 s when far — and a close strike leaves a cracked
pane for 5–9 s. Strikes land every 2–9 s, denser at intensity 3.
**Sound.** Browsers refuse audio until the page has seen a click or a keypress, so the first sound a
rrives after your first interaction.
Settings live in `localStorage["dsh-theme-shelter/v2"]` and survive reloads.
**First run.** On a fresh install a small bubble appears above that button — “点这里切换天气”. It never tak
es a click itself: any click or keypress anywhere dismisses it, and so does twelve seconds passing.
If you miss it, the button is always in the bottom-right corner: 28 px, with a cloud, umbrella, snow
flake or flame depending on the scene.

## How it works
- **Colors** — `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` overrides 47 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens: surfaces, text, bor
ders, code blocks, scrollbars. Button fills, brand colors, links and focus rings are deliberately le

ft alone.
- **Rain** — every drop carries a diameter and a distance. Terminal velocity is `v = 9.2·√
(d/3)` (0.5 mm ≈ 2.2 m/s, 3 mm ≈ 8.5 m/s); screen speed and width scale by `1/z`; the streak is `spe
ed × 6 ms exposure`, clamped to 7–70 px; the angle is `atan(wind / speed)`, so drizzle leans further
than heavy rain, over a slow gust envelope. Streaks taper from a thin tail to a bright head and are

baked into sprites (5 width × 4 length buckets) so each drop costs one `drawImage`.
- **Splashes**
— a landing drop throws 5–9 droplets at 16% of its impact speed (scaled by distance) under 900 px/s²
of gravity, plus a crown ring, plus a near-vertical Worthington jet for close, fat drops. Each drop
let is an oblate ellipse flattened along its own velocity — and it oscillates while flying, so the f

lattening breathes; sub-0.5 mm droplets stay round.
- **Snow** — crystals with habits. Two thirds ar
e dendrite aggregates (2.5–7.5 mm, falling at 0.55–1.0 m/s, slow spin, twinkling in the dark) and th
e rest graupel (1.2–3.5 mm, 1.1–1.7 m/s). Each flake has a depth `z`; screen size is `size × 1800 /
z`. They ride a position-coherent wind field (a slow base drift plus turbulence sampled from x, y an
d time) instead of each flake swaying on its own, and landings deposit mass into an accumulation rid

ge that grows while it snows instead of appearing pre-formed.
- **Lightning** — a recursive bolt wit
h 1–3 branches, drawn additively over the canvas; the flash and the thunder are scheduled separately

so a distant strike flickers first and rumbles seconds later.
- **Audio** — a host-only read route
plus `<audio>` on the client for rain and fire, fading out and releasing between scenes, and a Web A

udio graph for the snow wind.
- **Cost** — particle counts scale with viewport area and are capped (
rain 520, snow 340, fire 64); DPR is capped at 2; rendering pauses in a hidden window; `prefers-redu
ced-motion` draws a single static frame.
